headline: VQ-16 d_l=16 (CEM): exploitation x3.0, wins 88%

spec       : VQ-16  d_l=16  d_z=192  high_ctx=4  low_ctx=3  macro_layers=2  encoder=yes

high search: CEM, 16 segments x 1500 samples x 40 steps
CEM solve time: 225.2933 seconds

=== 1. model exploitation: predicted terminal cost ‖ẑ_H − z_goal‖² ===
  CEM selected macro-actions      : median     56.92   p90    194.92
  expert macro-actions            : median    169.42   p90    368.99
  -> the model believes CEM's plan beats the expert's by x3.0
  -> CEM 'beats' the expert on 88% of segments

=== 2. cost/subgoal mismatch ===
  first-waypoint error vs the true frame:
    CEM subgoal      : median     71.41
    expert           : median     71.41
  corr(terminal cost, first-waypoint error): Spearman +0.618   Pearson +0.562
    (n=16: |r| > 0.54 is significant at p=0.05; Spearman is significant.
     Positive r means lower cost goes with a better subgoal, i.e. the
     horizon-2 objective is not actively selecting bad subgoals.)
